name: Return Merge Field Names { Data }
purpose: Parses a string for merge-field tokens (default prefix "<<", suffix ">>") and returns the list of token strings found as JSON. Errors when the number of prefixes and suffixes differs. Transaction wrapper is used, but nothing is read from or written to records.
open_question: $fieldName includes the prefix and suffix text as written (Middle from start of prefix to end of suffix), so names come back like "<<FirstName>>"; the doc comment says "names". The returned array is built with JSON.Push on an unset $MergeFieldNames. Confirm the expected shape with the caller (script 481/480 consume names).

name: Create or Patch Merge Fields { MergeField }
purpose: Creates or patches several template merge fields at once: loops through the Fields array and calls _Create or Patch Merge Field for each with the activity id, template id and field name. Returns the number of fields processed. Transaction pattern; Fields and TemplateId required.
